---
description: Internetily design, UX, copy, and product-completeness guidance for user-facing frontend work.
applyTo: '{app,components,shop-ui,styles}/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}'
---

Read `DESIGN.md` before making a user-facing interface or copy change. Preserve the existing component library, tokens, brand terminology, appearance settings, and nearby interaction patterns.

For substantial UI builds, redesigns, polish, reviews, or connected frontend/backend flows, use the `netily-product-craft` skill in `.github/skills/netily-product-craft/SKILL.md` and load only its relevant references.

Do not invent metrics, testimonials, customers, provider results, or operational success. Account for applicable loading, empty, error, permission, disabled, processing, success, narrow-width, and recovery states. Verify rendered work in a browser before describing it as polished or production-ready.
